question: In activated human CD8 libraries, is 10-DE response attenuated versus WT, and does super-10 uniformly amplify or alter particular fixed Figure5 gene responses?
decision: Determine source fidelity and bounded normalization/library sensitivity; narrow any later signaling question without inferring functional selectivity.
strongest_rival: Broad attenuation, source-selected targets, donor/preparation confounding, relative normalization and individual-library variation could explain the patterns.
discriminator: Five direct/context RNA contrasts, separate published up/down panels, fixed target-excluded background amplitude and all single-library omissions on three frozen scales; no causal STAT discrimination.
exposure_record: Both published papers and Figure5 outcomes were read; metadata/QC and target mapping exposed. The v1 row-order failure and v2 keyed-annotation correction are retained. No treatment outcome calculation was inspected before this description freeze; prior exposure still makes this shared-source description, not confirmation.
biological_unit: Human donor/preparation; author reports two biological RNA replicates, but current deposited descriptive unit is a library.
nesting_and_overlap: Eight libraries, two treatment labels each; donor and preparation overlap across arms unknown. Genes nest in libraries; RNA is distinct from ELISA and phospho-flow.
population_and_selection: All 58735 stable-ID rows and eight named source libraries. Fixed universe CPM>=1 in at least two full-data libraries (12677), held unchanged for 27 cases. Exactly 23 Figure5A symbols and eight overlapping Figure5B targets; IL2 shown but below filter. Background excludes all target matches (12655).
contrast: 10-DE minus WT and super-10 minus WT; each active arm minus PBS, as differences of mean per-library log2(expression+1).
endpoint: All primary per-library log CPM and gene contrasts; target values, panel medians/member disagreement, descriptive through-origin amplitude and residuals; observed omission ranges.
methods: METHODS_V1.md fixes exact raw ID joins, CPM primary, median-ratio count-normalized CPM and deposited FPKM, +1/log2; nine views per scale; no post-result method changes. Fit beta=sum(x*y)/sum(x*x) on fixed background separately for DE and SUPER, x=WT-PBS. Preserve all five contrasts and residuals.
missingness_and_exclusions: No library exclusions or stable-ID collapse. Exact unique target mappings qualified. IL2 excluded only from summaries by fixed expression rule, retained in values. No favorable substitutes or extra membership search.
multiplicity: Three overlapping published panels, 23 unique targets, five contrasts, three scales and nine views; no p-values, FDR, CIs, bootstrap, equivalence or inferential model.
precision_basis: Finite-library description only; omission ranges do not estimate population uncertainty, and donor independence remains unknown.
interpretation_limit: RNA is not STAT activation, secretion, cytotoxicity, myeloid suppression, repair, persistence or protection. Shared PBS axes and exposed source panels are not independent evidence. Super-10 need not amplify every gene. No donor or exact-author replay inference.
stop_rule: Stop on source/code hash mismatch, invalid matrix/counts, changed qualified ID mapping, empty positive reference or zero amplitude denominator. Preserve failure and unfavorable outcomes; no threshold relaxation or new targets.
amendment_reason: Initial numerical description after source qualification_v2; prior metadata v1 failure is preserved, not overwritten.
